Smoke evidence for the mechanism on the FAILING schedule run 35787715713: both attempts died with `Timeout 60000ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate` at the toPass line, and the Vite log shows the generated-registry/i18n reload landing inside the assertion window. Trace timing confirms the enclosed `page.goto('/system/modules')` consumed the whole 60s predicate window before returning, so the row could never be observed.

The failure snapshot still shows the generator wizard (/system/generator) rather than the module list: the navigation had not completed when the predicate deadline expired. This is what ruled out the 'row text changed' and 'module not registered' hypotheses — the API poll above the assertion had already proven the module ready.
